summary: Chapter 053’s owned chronology is supported from the Chinese units. Sima Yu has no stated birth year; ages five and twenty-three sui are preserved without conversion. Deaths of Yu, Xie, Jiang, Bin, Zang, Shang, Jia, Liu Zhen, Sun Lü, Cheng Ju, and the undated prior death of the Lady of Yicheng are present. The pivotal 九年十二月 deposition converts to AD 300 because Yuankang 9 month 12 begins in that Western year (proleptic Gregorian); the conventional 299 label of 元康九年 does not date the month. 明年正月 / 永康元年 and later 三月, 六月 events are Yongkang 1, AD 300; 永寧元年 is 301; 太安元年 is 302. Tutor appointments are correctly bounded 290–291. Active hints match personal living events; retrospective citations (Xuan, Yang, Shen Sheng, Xiao Ji, Jian, Li, Huguan, Qianqiu, posthumous titles) are not fed into life years. s0168 六月己卯 competes with the Hui annals’ 六月壬寅 and is not a day of month 6 on the reconstructed 庚寅朔; year 300 is still shared.
